groups.heading: Student Learning Outcomes
outcomes: Develop, demonstrate, and articulate professional skills, behaviors, and workplace competencies necessary for successful industry employment through on-the-job experiences.
Identify, write, and work towards completing Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant and Time-based (SMART) workplace or career goals for professional growth in industry.
